comment: labband EXACT-BAND held-out benchmark (16 scenarios, 4 per sun rank). One zone, target rank 2 EXACTLY (band 100-300 lux; rank bounds [50,100,300]) — OVERSHOOT FAILS, so the strong lamp (+400 on its own = 425) and unshaded high daylight (sun 900 open blinds = 475) are signature traps. Physics: daylight = (Z1Blinds ? 0.50*Sun : 0); if (Awning deployed) daylight *= 0.25; Z1 = 25 + (StrongLamp?400:0) + (WeakLamp?150:0) + daylight. Sun in {0,100,400,900} via bounds [50,200,600]. Energy/tick: strong 2, weak 1, blinds 0, awning 0 — daylight routes are free, so at equal step count the blind/awning route beats a lamp route. The Awning is the INVERSE actuator (shades the OPEN daylight path to 25%): a no-op while blinds are closed or sun=0. INTENDED OPTIMAL ROUTES per id: 1 (sun0, all off, 25): weak ON -> 175. 2 (sun0, strong, 425): strong OFF + weak ON -> 175. 3 (sun0, strong+weak, 575): strong OFF -> 175 (one step strips the overshoot). 4 (sun0, weak+blinds, 175): hold (blinds contribute 0 at sun0). 5 (sun1, blinds, 75): weak ON -> 225. 6 (sun1, strong, 425): strong OFF + weak ON -> 175 (blinds would only reach 75). 7 (sun1, strong+blinds, 475): strong OFF (75) + weak ON -> 225. 8 (sun1, weak+blinds, 225): hold. 9 (sun2, all off, 25): open blinds -> 225 at ZERO energy (beats weak ON -> 175 @1/tick). 10 (sun2, strong+blinds, 625): strong OFF -> 225 (one step, zero-energy result). 11 (sun2, weak+blinds, 375 combo-overshoot): weak OFF -> 225 (deploying awning also lands 225 but keeps paying the weak lamp). 12 (sun2, blinds+awning, 75): retract awning -> 225 (awning trap: shading kills the only free source). 13 (sun3, blinds, 475 unshaded-daylight trap): deploy awning -> 137.5 (one step, zero energy; closing blinds instead needs a lamp afterwards). 14 (sun3, strong+blinds, 875 deepest overshoot): strong OFF + deploy awning -> 137.5 (both orders stay rank 3 in between). 15 (sun3, weak+blinds+awning, 287.5): hold (near the 300 ceiling — any addition overshoots). 16 (sun3, blinds+awning, 137.5): hold (awning already correctly deployed).
